strings: r_c0 sits with m_c long into the night, just letting {PRONOUN/m_c/object} lean against {PRONOUN/r_c0/object} tired and exhausted. m_c just wonders when, if ever sleep will come again.
Longer and longer time seems to stretch with m_c been unable to get any sleep.
m_c's sleeplessness doesn't seem to be leaving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} alone as {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/take/takes} more and more night time patrols just to keep busy.
